name: guardrail-manager
description: Hooks that catch the mistakes sessions make around shared working trees and skipped review steps: warn when other Claude Code sessions are active in the same checkout, restate the branch before a git commit or push, remind about a repo-declared review policy the transcript shows was skipped, stop a new worktree once the repo has a budget's worth, pointing the session at finished ones to reuse or remove (asking you only when all hold live work), send a session that stops to ask "shall I merge?" back to merge and continue, and deny any git command that resolves a conflict with -X ours/theirs, -s ours or checkout --ours/--theirs
